title: Salvation from the Skies
front_description: Above Geonosis' warrior-filled arena, six Republic gunships descend fast, landing in a cluster around a handful of Jedi. Within seconds, clone troopers spill out and start firing ceaselessly at Dooku's battle droids. There is a barrage of laserfire that bounces off these armored ships. Other Republic gunships circle towering stalagmites as they head directly toward the assembly point.
back_description: A full-color production painting of the Republic gunship transports by Doug Chiang.
